name: supply_chain_list_fulfillment_warehouses
description:
List the company's own fulfillment warehouses (3PLs, own warehouses, FBM/Shopify/wholesale shipping locations) that are eligible for non-FBA replenishment planning, ordered by 90-day units sold.

IMPORTANT — flat input: pass all parameters at top level. Required: company_id (integer).

WHAT COUNTS AS A FULFILLMENT WAREHOUSE: a warehouse that physically fulfilled invoices — stock outflows posted by Invoice V1/V2 documents in the company FIFO mode. This covers Shopify, wholesale, other channels and FBM Amazon orders. Amazon FBA/AWD, transit/transfer and 'Lost & Found' locations and deleted warehouses are NOT planning-eligible (is_planning_eligible_type = false); FBA replenishment is covered by supply_chain_list_fba_replenishment_candidates. is_fulfillment = eligible type AND units sold in the last 90 days > 0. By default only is_fulfillment warehouses are returned; pass include_non_eligible=true to see every warehouse referenced by invoices.

FIELDS: units_sold_30d / units_sold_90d, items_sold_90d, item_invoice_lines_90d, sales_channels_90d (sales channels inferred from the invoices' sales channel), first/last sale date, and lead-time history: lead_time_events_365d, median_lead_time_days, p80_lead_time_days — measured from arrived shipments (created/shipped -> arrived) and received purchase orders (PO date -> received) into the warehouse over 365 days. Planning defaults: default_lead_time_days 30 (used when < 3 history events), default_safety_stock_days 10 (multiplied by the ABCD class safety-stock multiplier), default_replenishment_frequency_days 14.

Use the returned warehouse_id values as warehouse_ids in supply_chain_list_warehouse_restock_candidates.

include_non_eligible.description: When true, also return warehouses that are referenced by invoices but not planning-eligible (FBA/AWD/transit/Lost & Found/deleted) or that had no sales in the last 90 days.

examples.description: Every warehouse referenced by invoices, including FBA and transit locations
